data.heading: About CareLine Hospital
data.subheading: Twenty-five years of compassionate, affordable and ethical healthcare.

data.heading: From a 30-bed clinic to a multi-speciality hospital
data.description:
CareLine began in 1998 as a small clinic founded by three doctors who wanted honest, high-quality care to be within reach of every family. Today we are a 220-bed hospital with more than 120 specialists, but our promise is the same.

We invest in technology and training so that treatments once available only in big cities are available close to home.

data.heading: Frequently asked questions
data.description: Can't find your answer? Call the help desk and we'll be glad to help.

items.question: Do I need an appointment to see a doctor?
items.answer: Appointments are recommended so you can skip the queue, but walk-in patients are seen on a token basis during OPD hours.

items.question: Which insurance and cashless schemes do you accept?
items.answer: We are empanelled with most major insurers and TPAs for cashless treatment. Please bring your policy card and a photo ID to the insurance desk.

items.question: How do I collect my lab reports?
items.answer: Reports are sent by SMS and email once ready, and printed copies can be collected from the lab reception.

items.question: Is parking available at the hospital?
items.answer: Yes, free parking for patients and visitors is available in the basement and behind the main block.

data.content:
This policy explains how CareLine Hospital collects, uses and protects the personal information you share through this website.

Information we collect

When you request an appointment or send a message we collect your name, phone number, email address and the details you provide, such as the department and preferred date.

How we use it

We use this information only to respond to you and to arrange your care. Medical records are handled under applicable health-data regulations and are never shared for marketing.

Contact

For any privacy question, contact the hospital help desk using the details on the contact page.

By using this website you agree to these terms.

Medical information

Content on this website is for general information only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice. In an emergency, call the hospital's emergency number or go to the nearest emergency department.

Appointments

An appointment request is confirmed only after our help desk contacts you. Consultation timings may change without notice.

Prices

Package prices shown are indicative and may change. The final amount is confirmed at the hospital.
